title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty to the model based on the absolute values of the coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this affect the model's performance on the training data?

title: Impact on Training MSE
text: Consider how adding a penalty term to the loss function might affect the model's ability to fit the training data perfectly. What happens to the training error when the model is less flexible?

title: Effect of LASSO on Training MSE
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model might not fit the training data as closely as before. What is a possible effect on the MSE of the training data?
